title: Report a missing item
summary: Flask: Report a missing item. Inspect the status with curl -i.
introduction: Returning a response with 404 tells the client that this book was not found. Open GET /missing.
learningObjectives: Report a missing item with Flask

blocks.text: In a practice folder create a virtual environment and install Flask with python -m pip install flask. Save one example as app.py and run python app.py. Use http://127.0.0.1:8000.

blocks.title: Report a missing item

blocks.text: The response tuple contains JSON plus status 404. Both pieces are sent together.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A failure should not pretend to be a successful 200 response.
